title: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle

line: Murakami is my favourite author. My whole Letterboxd review of Burning, a film made from one of his stories, was one word: “murakami-esque”.

title: Kafka on the Shore

line: Two stories that take turns: a boy who runs away from home at fifteen, and an old man who can talk to cats.

title: 1Q84
author: Haruki Murakami
line: Set in a 1984 that is not quite 1984, where the sky has two moons.

title: Kitchen

line: After her grandmother dies, a young woman in Tokyo falls asleep beside the hum of the refrigerator.

title: The Elegant Universe
author: Brian Greene
line: Brian Greene on string theory and the search for one theory of everything, the question my 2019 physics blog kept circling.
